title: Skiff Line
shortDescription: A line of flat boats, one of them not ours.
longDescription: Flat skiffs knock the piling. One has a Collegium knot. One has a thief's knot and a stoat who will not move. North is the willow bend. West is the slip. East is the mill-race. South is the cargo hollow.

fixtures.name: Thief Knot
fixtures.lookDescription: A knot that is not the landing's. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Marram's knot is elaborate and meant to hold. This one is fast and mean, a knot for people who plan to leave quickly. The skiff under it is ours. The knot is not.
